All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. (The initial call timed out, but I verified via `list_incidents` that it was created and is open.)
